titleZh: 奋力推动“十五五”知识产权事业高质量发展（申长雨署名文章）
titleEn: Vigorously Promote High-Quality IP Development During the 15th Five-Year Plan (by Shen Changyu)
sumZh: 国家知识产权局局长申长雨解读《知识产权保护和运用“十五五”规划》，提出从优化保护环境、提升运用效能、健全综合管理、深化国际合作四方面推动知识产权事业高质量发展。
sumEn: CNIPA chief Shen Changyu interprets the 15th Five-Year IP Plan, proposing to advance high-quality IP development through better protection, application, governance and international cooperation.

titleZh: 专访陶凯元：涉人工智能知识产权裁判规则需要不断探索
titleEn: Interview with Tao Kaiyuan: AI-Related IP Adjudication Rules Need Continuous Exploration
sumZh: 最高法院副院长陶凯元认为应在AI产业发展与著作权人权益保护间寻求平衡，正推进涉AI、数据产权司法政策文件起草，并推动知识产权特别程序法立法。
sumEn: SPC Vice President Tao Kaiyuan calls for balancing AI industry growth and copyright protection, advancing judicial policy documents on AI and data property rights.

titleZh: 大力促进知识产权价值实现（申长雨署名文章）
titleEn: Vigorously Promote the Realization of IP Value (by Shen Changyu)
sumZh: 申长雨指出我国知识产权转化运用存在“不能转、不愿转、不敢转、不会转、不便转”五大问题，提出深化权益分配改革、打通转移转化堵点、培育知识产权要素市场。
sumEn: Shen Changyu identifies five barriers to IP commercialization and proposes reforms in rights distribution, technology transfer and the IP factor market.

titleZh: 肖冬梅：规范商标使用 整治误导行为——《商标法》第五次修订新增第五十六条解读
titleEn: Xiao Dongmei: Regulating Trademark Use and Curbing Misleading Conduct — Interpreting New Article 56 of the Trademark Law
sumZh: 湘潭大学教授肖冬梅解读商标法新增第五十六条，认为“限期改正、梯度罚款、逾期撤销”的规制体系标志商标治理从“重注册”转向“强治理”。
sumEn: Professor Xiao Dongmei interprets Article 56, arguing the new rules mark a shift in trademark governance from registration-oriented to use-oriented regulation.

titleZh: 王艳芳：完善商标使用条款护航数字经济发展
titleEn: Wang Yanfang: Improving Trademark Use Clauses to Safeguard the Digital Economy
sumZh: 华东政法大学教授王艳芳认为新商标法明确互联网环境下的商标使用、突出使用的基础地位，推动商标制度从“注册导向”向“使用导向”转型。
sumEn: Professor Wang Yanfang argues the revised law clarifies online trademark use and shifts the system from registration-oriented to use-oriented.

titleZh: 余俊：系统重塑商标产权保护制度
titleEn: Yu Jun: Systematically Reshaping the Trademark Property Protection System
sumZh: 北京化工大学教授余俊认为新商标法实现“产权保护先于行政管理、实体条件先于程序规则、真实使用先于形式注册”三层重塑，使商标法成长为市场经济基础性财产制度。
sumEn: Professor Yu Jun argues the revised law prioritizes property protection over administration and real use over formal registration, reshaping trademark law as a foundational property system.

titleZh: 杜颖：贴合新发展需求的系统重塑——《商标法》第五次修改综观
titleEn: Du Ying: A Systematic Reshaping Fitting New Development Needs — Overview of the Fifth Trademark Law Revision
sumZh: 中央财经大学教授杜颖系统解读商标法第五次修改，指出其在赋能科技创新、强化商标使用、治理恶意注册、护航企业出海四方面的制度创新。
sumEn: Professor Du Ying analyzes the revision's innovations in enabling innovation, strengthening use, curbing bad-faith registration and supporting enterprises going global.

titleZh: 张伟君：完善驰名商标保护制度 维护我国企业境外权益
titleEn: Zhang Weijun: Improving Well-Known Trademark Protection to Safeguard Chinese Enterprises' Overseas Rights
sumZh: 浙江大学教授张伟君认为新商标法将跨类反淡化保护扩展至未注册驰名商标，并新增境外维权驰名确认机制，主动对接CPTPP高标准经贸规则。
sumEn: Professor Zhang Weijun argues the revision extends anti-dilution protection to unregistered well-known marks and adds a confirmation mechanism for overseas rights protection.

titleZh: 管育鹰：新修订商标法对“心机商标”的治理及其实施路径
titleEn: Guan Yuying: Governing 'Crafty Trademarks' under the Revised Trademark Law and Its Implementation Path
sumZh: 中国社科院研究员管育鹰剖析“心机商标”成因，主张审查机关站在消费者视角强化授权环节过滤，辅以第五十六条事后撤销，实现全链条治理。
sumEn: Researcher Guan Yuying calls for stricter ex-ante examination plus post-hoc revocation to govern misleading 'crafty trademarks' across the whole chain.

titleZh: 业界聚焦“人工智能+”背景下的知识产权保护
titleEn: Industry Focuses on IP Protection in the 'AI+' Context
sumZh: 中国人民大学杨东、北京大学张平等学者在“人工智能+”知识产权论坛上，围绕AIGC版权认定、数据训练合规、AI治理原则分享多元观点。
sumEn: Scholars including Yang Dong and Zhang Ping share views on AIGC copyright, data training compliance and AI governance principles at an 'AI+' IP forum.

titleZh: 筑牢新兴领域知识产权保护屏障
titleEn: Building a Strong IP Protection Barrier for Emerging Fields
sumZh: 华东政法大学教授阮开欣、华中科技大学教授熊琦等专家认为我国知识产权战略正加速向AI、大数据等新业态延伸，应从立法与司法层面系统完善新兴领域保护制度。
sumEn: Experts argue China's IP strategy is extending to AI and big data, calling for systematic improvement of protection systems through legislation and adjudication.

titleZh: 开拓新时代高校专利转化运用新路径（任其龙院士署名文章）
titleEn: Opening New Paths for University Patent Commercialization in the New Era (by Ren Qilong)
sumZh: 中国工程院院士任其龙解读《专利转化运用专项行动方案》，提出围绕“项目发现—评价审批—转化运营—作价增值”全链条开辟高校专利转化新路径。
sumEn: Academician Ren Qilong interprets the patent commercialization action plan, proposing a full-chain path from project discovery to valuation and operation.

titleZh: 人工智能生成物知识产权保护的争议阐释与应然面向
titleEn: Disputes and Future Directions of IP Protection for AI-Generated Works
sumZh: 天津市检察院康赞等提出对AI生成物构建有限拟制主体制度、区分纳入客体范围、分阶段动态审查标准与“投入与贡献占比”的权属规则。
sumEn: The authors propose a limited fictional subject system, differentiated object scope, phased review standards and contribution-based ownership rules for AI-generated works.

titleZh: 聚焦前沿议题 “人工智能+”知识产权论坛在人民大学举办
titleEn: 'AI+' IP Forum Held at Renmin University Focusing on Frontier Issues
sumZh: 杨东提出共票理论重构平台责任，李扬主张创设“生成式人工智能数据训练权”反对无偿利用，刘佳欣则认为版权治理应坚持避风港规则与多元共治。
sumEn: Yang Dong proposes a co-ownership theory for platform liability; Li Yang advocates a data training right; Liu Jiaxin supports safe-harbor rules and multi-stakeholder governance.

titleZh: 独家专访最高检副检察长史卫忠：加强知识产权司法保护 守护企业创新动能
titleEn: Exclusive Interview with SPP Deputy Procurator-General Shi Weizhong on IP Judicial Protection
sumZh: 最高检副检察长史卫忠提出从全链条打击侵权、追赃挽损、综合保护、治罪与治理并重四方面加强对民营企业、中小企业知识产权司法保护。
sumEn: Shi Weizhong outlines four measures to strengthen IP judicial protection for private and small enterprises, including full-chain crackdowns and integrated protection.

titleZh: 高通钱堃：知识产权保护体系，有利于促进创新驱动的高质量发展
titleEn: Qualcomm's Qian Kun: IP Protection System Benefits Innovation-Driven High-Quality Development
sumZh: 高通全球高级副总裁钱堃认为提升知识产权保护的效率和可预期性、增强创新主体长期投入信心，有助于推动新兴技术领域和产业创新发展。
sumEn: Qualcomm's Qian Kun argues that improving IP protection efficiency and predictability bolsters long-term innovation confidence and industry development.

titleZh: 重磅发布《2026 AI+知识产权大数据产业应用白皮书》
titleEn: Release of the 2026 AI + IP Big Data Industry Application White Paper
sumZh: 星河智源联合IPR Daily发布白皮书，提出AI+知识产权是数据、制度、平台、流程和服务能力共同重组的系统性议题，竞争正从工具使用转向数据与规则的综合能力竞争。
sumEn: The white paper argues AI+IP is a systemic issue of data, institutions and capabilities, with competition shifting from tools to integrated data and rule capabilities.

titleZh: 人民网评：从“量”入“质”，知识产权赋能创新发展
titleEn: People's Daily Online Review: From Quantity to Quality, IP Empowers Innovation
sumZh: 评论认为我国知识产权工作从追求数量转向提高质量，专利转让许可、品牌价值、知识产权使用费出口等指标显示知识产权持续赋能实体经济。
sumEn: The commentary argues China's IP work is shifting from quantity to quality, with commercialization and brand metrics showing IP empowering the real economy.

titleZh: 六项主要指标谋定“十五五”高质量发展
titleEn: Six Key Indicators Chart High-Quality Development for the 15th Five-Year Plan
sumZh: 何平、任声策等专家解读知识产权“十五五”规划6项预期性指标，认为其形成从高质量创造、产业化落地到营商环境优化的“指挥”链条。
sumEn: Experts interpret the six indicative IP indicators of the 15th Five-Year Plan as forming a chain from quality creation to business environment optimization.

titleZh: 专家声音：数据赋权的法律实践评价与制度创建构想（吴汉东）
titleEn: Expert Voice: Data Empowerment in Legal Practice and Institutional Design (by Wu Handong)
sumZh: 吴汉东评析欧盟数据产权制度的试错经验，提出中国未来“数据产权条例”应涵盖宗旨、主体、客体、权益、登记、合同、救济等规范构成。
sumEn: Wu Handong reviews the EU data property regime and proposes the normative structure of a future Chinese data property rights regulation.

titleZh: 海外知识产权服务“向前看”
titleEn: Looking Ahead in Overseas IP Services
sumZh: 黄晖、卢海君等专家认为知识产权已从出海企业专项法律问题变为影响投资决策的重要因素，海外知识产权服务应从事后维权前移至投资决策与价值发掘。
sumEn: Experts argue IP services for overseas investment should shift from post-hoc rights protection to pre-investment decision-making and value discovery.

titleZh: 知识产权：有风载马 凭树飞花
titleEn: IP: Riding the Wind and Blooming with the Trees
sumZh: 文章解读政府工作报告，认为知识产权明确列入“生产性服务业”，应促进“有为政府”和“有效市场”结合，推动知识产权服务扩能提质。
sumEn: The article argues IP is listed as a producer service industry and calls for combining an effective government with an efficient market to improve IP services.

titleZh: 高质量开启知识产权强国建设新阶段
titleEn: Opening a New Stage of IP Power-Building with High Quality
sumZh: 文章总结知识产权强国建设第一阶段成效与经验，提出“十五五”要更好服务高水平科技创新、高水平对外开放和高标准市场体系建设。
sumEn: The article reviews phase-one achievements of IP power-building and outlines tasks to better serve innovation, opening-up and market system building.

titleZh: 让创新底气更足 让新兴赛道更宽——2026中国知识产权保护高层论坛侧记
titleEn: Boosting Innovation Confidence and Broadening Emerging Tracks — Sidelights of the 2026 High-Level Forum on IP Protection
sumZh: 马一德等专家在高层论坛上提出AI经济需要新型知识产权保护体系，强调以前瞻性制度布局重新定义保护创新的方式。
sumEn: Experts including Ma Yide argue the AI economy needs a new IP protection system with forward-looking institutional arrangements.

srcZh: 贵州省大数据发展管理局
srcEn: Guizhou Provincial Big Data Development Administration
titleZh: 专家解读：加强数据产权保护和安全治理（丁红发）
titleEn: Expert Interpretation: Strengthening Data Property Protection and Security Governance (by Ding Hongfa)
sumZh: 贵州财经大学副教授丁红发提出统筹发展和安全，将安全贯穿数据产权取得、流转、行使全过程，完善国有企业数据与公共数据安全保护。
sumEn: Ding Hongfa proposes integrating security throughout data property acquisition, circulation and exercise, and improving protection of SOE and public data.

titleZh: 刘鑫：加快高校科技成果转化 完善AI等新兴领域知识产权保护
titleEn: Liu Xin: Accelerating University Tech Commercialization and Improving IP Protection in AI and Emerging Fields
sumZh: 西南交大研究员刘鑫建议四川“十五五”期间构建全链条、专业化、协同化的新兴领域知识产权保护体系，以AI赋能打通高校成果转化堵点。
sumEn: Liu Xin suggests Sichuan build a full-chain, specialized and coordinated IP protection system for emerging fields and use AI to unblock university tech commercialization.

titleZh: 一场“最前沿”“最关注”“最期盼”的知识产权司法保护主题座谈会侧记
titleEn: Sidelights of a Symposium on IP Judicial Protection Focusing on Frontier, Concerned and Expected Issues
sumZh: 潘教峰、冯晓青、王迁等专家在最高检座谈会上就AI生成物权属、新兴领域检察监督、商业秘密保护等提出建议，史卫忠回应将以“严保护”导向推进六方面工作。
sumEn: Experts at an SPP symposium advise on AI works ownership, emerging-field supervision and trade secret protection, with a strict-protection approach promised.

titleZh: 东湖评论：知识产权为新质生产力积蓄创新底气
titleEn: Donghu Commentary: IP Builds Innovation Confidence for New Quality Productive Forces
sumZh: 评论认为知识产权既是保护创新成果的屏障，又是成果落地转化的桥梁，优质产权制度能激活创新成果的产业价值，助力新质生产力发展。
sumEn: The commentary argues IP both protects innovation and bridges commercialization, activating industrial value and boosting new quality productive forces.

titleZh: 知识产权如何服务国家发展大局？四个维度读懂“十五五”新布局
titleEn: How Does IP Serve National Development? Understanding the 15th Five-Year Layout from Four Dimensions
sumZh: 国家知识产权局发展研究中心主任刘新民从保护、运用、治理、国际合作四个维度解读“十五五”规划，提出以行政裁决快速解决纠纷等亮点。
sumEn: CNIPA research center director Liu Xinmin interprets the plan across protection, application, governance and cooperation, highlighting expedited administrative adjudication.

titleZh: 徐伟律师：AI时代知识产权刑事风险的司法治理与辩护应对
titleEn: Lawyer Xu Wei: Judicial Governance of IP Criminal Risks and Defense Strategies in the AI Era
sumZh: 京都律所徐伟梳理AI时代四类知识产权刑事犯罪形态，提出从合理使用抗辩、技术中立防线、商业秘密要件解构等维度展开精细化刑事辩护。
sumEn: Xu Wei analyzes four types of IP crimes in the AI era and proposes refined defense strategies on fair use, technology neutrality and trade secret elements.

titleZh: AI知识产权保护写入“十五五”规划（肖尤丹）
titleEn: AI IP Protection Written into the 15th Five-Year Plan (by Xiao Youdan)
sumZh: 中科院研究员肖尤丹认为知识产权政策角色已从“保护创新成果”转向“支撑供给”，国际化由外部增量变为内嵌于全链条的战略变量。
sumEn: Xiao Youdan argues the role of IP policy has shifted from protecting innovation to supporting supply, with internationalization embedded across the whole chain.

titleZh: 北京：2026中关村科技成果转化50人论坛聚焦专利转化运用
titleEn: Beijing: 2026 Zhongguancun Tech Transfer Forum Focuses on Patent Commercialization
sumZh: 与会专家认为尽管高校和科研院所专利申请量质齐升，仍需加大高质量专利供给，强化企业创新主体地位并加快技术经理人队伍建设。
sumEn: Experts note the need for more high-quality patent supply, stronger enterprise roles and faster development of technology managers.

titleZh: 知识产权赋能“十五五”高质量发展 2026上海浦江知识产权国际论坛在沪举办
titleEn: IP Empowers High-Quality Development: 2026 Shanghai Pujiang IP Forum Held
sumZh: 田力普、阎晓宏等专家在浦江论坛上指出AI正深刻重塑知识产权保护体系，呼吁摒弃著作权“数量至上”并加快数据版权立法落地。
sumEn: Experts including Tian Lipu and Yan Xiaohong note AI is reshaping the IP system and call for abandoning copyright quantity obsession and accelerating data copyright legislation.

titleZh: 郃中林：加强技术类知识产权司法保护 助力加快高水平科技自立自强
titleEn: He Zhonglin: Strengthening Judicial Protection of Technology IP to Advance Sci-Tech Self-Reliance
sumZh: 最高法知识产权法庭副庭长郃中林系统阐述八个技术类知识产权司法保护理念，涵盖有利、有力、有效、高效、重点、平等、诚信、协同保护。
sumEn: He Zhonglin elaborates eight judicial protection concepts for technology IP, covering favorable, forceful, effective, efficient, prioritized, equal, integrity and coordinated protection.

titleZh: 专访张晓强：我国发明专利数量世界第一，但科研院校职称评价指标应纳入科研成果转化应用程度
titleEn: Interview with Zhang Xiaoqiang: China Leads in Invention Patents, but Evaluation Should Include Commercialization
sumZh: 国家发改委原副主任张晓强认为提高科技自立自强水平需加强科技成果转化运用，主张把科研成果转化应用程度纳入科研院校职称评价指标并增加权重。
sumEn: Zhang Xiaoqiang argues for stronger tech commercialization and incorporating commercialization outcomes into academic title evaluation indicators.

titleZh: 单志广：建设开放共享安全的全国一体化数据市场
titleEn: Shan Zhiguang: Building an Open, Shared and Secure National Integrated Data Market
sumZh: 国家信息中心单志广提出建设全国一体化数据市场需把握场内外“两个市场”协同、多层次交易场所、服务机构分工协作、合规安全流通四大关键问题。
sumEn: Shan Zhiguang identifies four key issues for building an integrated data market: on/off-exchange coordination, multi-level venues, service specialization and secure circulation.

titleZh: 专家解读：开展数据产权登记，助力数据要素价值释放（赵治纲）
titleEn: Expert Interpretation: Data Property Registration Unlocks Data Factor Value (by Zhao Zhigang)
sumZh: 中国财科院赵治纲认为《数据产权登记工作指引》为数据权属认定提供权威解决方案，数据产权登记凭证可作为数据资产入表、融资担保的依据。
sumEn: Zhao Zhigang argues the registration guidelines provide an authoritative solution for data ownership and a basis for data asset capitalization and financing.

titleZh: 专家解读：鼓励确权用数创新 激发数据市场活力（王晨）
titleEn: Expert Interpretation: Encouraging Data Rights and Use Innovation to Vitalize the Data Market (by Wang Chen)
sumZh: 清华大学王晨提出以“不可逆性、非相似性、价值增值性”三原则判定衍生数据，构建以产权确认为核心、激励“投入—创造—收益”良性循环的市场供给体系。
sumEn: Wang Chen proposes three principles for identifying derivative data and a rights-confirmation-centered supply system that incentivizes an investment-creation-return cycle.

srcZh: 全球智慧数字科技研究院
srcEn: Global Intelligence Digital Technology Research Institute
titleZh: 《商业秘密保护规定》落地实施的国内价值与全球深远意义
titleEn: The Domestic Value and Global Significance of Implementing the Trade Secret Protection Regulations
sumZh: 文章认为新规首次将数据、算法纳入商业秘密法定客体并确立数字化保密措施标准，为全球商业秘密法律数字化改革和发展中国家立法提供中国方案。
sumEn: The article argues the new rules first incorporate data and algorithms into trade secret protection, offering a Chinese model for global digital trade secret reform.

titleZh: 专家话两会：释放数据要素潜力，建设强大国内市场（陈煜波）
titleEn: Expert on Two Sessions: Unleashing Data Factor Potential to Build a Strong Domestic Market (by Chen Yubo)
sumZh: 清华大学陈煜波指出供需数据“割裂”是制约内需的深层堵点，应培育数据流通服务机构“中间层”，让平台数据真正流向传统制造企业。
sumEn: Chen Yubo argues the supply-demand data disconnect is a deep bottleneck for domestic demand, calling for a service 'middle layer' to flow platform data to manufacturers.

titleZh: 马一德：让学生在校即“上战场”，破解知识产权人才培养与产业需求脱节
titleEn: Ma Yide: Let Students 'Enter the Battlefield' on Campus to Bridge IP Talent and Industry Needs
sumZh: 国科大知识产权学院院长马一德认为新时期知识产权人才要懂法律、技术、市场和国际规则，需打破高校与产业壁垒，构建产学研用闭环。
sumEn: Ma Yide argues new-era IP talent must understand law, technology, markets and international rules, requiring closer industry-university integration.

titleZh: 宋天一：2026年《商业秘密保护规定》要点解读与点评
titleEn: Song Tianyi: Key Points and Commentary on the 2026 Trade Secret Protection Regulations
sumZh: 宋天一解读新规认为其系统强化行政执法在商业秘密保护中的功能定位，新增远程办公保密要求并首次明确“云盘违规传输”等侵权边界。
sumEn: Song Tianyi interprets the rules as strengthening administrative enforcement, adding remote-work confidentiality and clarifying cloud-transfer infringement boundaries.

titleZh: 张浩然：《商业秘密保护规定》新规解读
titleEn: Zhang Haoran: Interpreting the New Trade Secret Protection Regulations
sumZh: 中国社科院副研究员张浩然解读新规，指出其从12条扩容到31条，完善执法机制并填补权利主体、侵权例外、域外管辖等制度空白，迈出专门立法重要一步。
sumEn: Zhang Haoran interprets the rules' expansion to 31 articles, filling gaps in rights subjects, exceptions and extraterritorial jurisdiction toward specialized legislation.

titleZh: 2026年商业秘密新规全面落地：算法、数据首次入法，企业如何搭建“攻守兼备”的防护体系
titleEn: 2026 Trade Secret Rules Fully Implemented: Algorithms and Data Enter Law for the First Time
sumZh: 李章虎律师团队解读新规认为算法、数据首次入法标志着商业秘密保护进入“亿元判赔”时代，企业应建立“制度+技术+管理”三位一体的保密体系。
sumEn: The team interprets that algorithms and data entering law marks a billion-yuan damages era, urging enterprises to build institution-technology-management protection systems.

titleZh: 中国网评：从“半年45.3万件发明专利”看中国经济高质量发展逻辑
titleEn: China.org.cn Commentary: 453,000 Invention Patents in Half a Year Reflect High-Quality Development
sumZh: 评论认为236万件高价值发明专利、知识产权使用费出口额增长64.9%等数据折射创新从“量”到“质”的跃升，知识产权正成为服务贸易新名片。
sumEn: The commentary argues high-value patents and surging IP royalty exports reflect a quantity-to-quality shift, making IP a new calling card for trade in services.

titleZh: 2026年海外知识产权保护新趋势：企业必须关注的5大变化
titleEn: Five Major Changes in Overseas IP Protection Trends Companies Must Watch in 2026
sumZh: 文章研判2026年海外知识产权保护的五大变化：区域协同诉讼、AIGC产权界定清晰化、数据主权介入IP流程、海关执法数字化、绿色技术专利争夺白热化。
sumEn: The article forecasts five 2026 trends: regional coordinated litigation, clearer AIGC rights, data sovereignty in IP, digital customs enforcement and green-tech patent races.

titleZh: 着力提升知识产权运用效益——访全国政协常委、国家知识产权局局长申长雨
titleEn: Improving IP Application Efficiency — Interview with CNIPA Chief Shen Changyu
sumZh: 申长雨在专访中阐述盘活存量专利、支持中小企业、强链增效、激发内生动力、建设要素市场等提升知识产权运用效益的举措与成效。
sumEn: Shen Changyu details measures to revitalize stock patents, support SMEs, strengthen industrial chains and build the IP factor market.

titleZh: 申长雨：加强新兴领域知识产权保护 全力支撑新质生产力发展
titleEn: Shen Changyu: Strengthening IP Protection in Emerging Fields to Support New Quality Productive Forces
sumZh: 申长雨接受中国日报专访表示将完善AI、大数据等新兴领域知识产权保护制度，最新专利审查指南首次以“人工智能、大数据”设专章，强化AI伦理审查。
sumEn: Shen Changyu says China will improve IP protection for AI and big data, with the patent examination guidelines adding a dedicated AI and big data chapter.

titleZh: 国科大举办“知识产权赋能科技创新和产业创新深度融合研讨会”
titleEn: UCAS Holds Seminar on IP Empowering Deep Integration of Sci-Tech and Industrial Innovation
sumZh: 马一德、潘教峰、阎文军等专家在国科大研讨会上认为知识产权是激励创新、保障成果转化的关键支撑，未来十年是知识产权学科发展的黄金机遇期。
sumEn: Experts at a UCAS seminar argue IP is key to innovation and commercialization, with the next decade a golden opportunity for the IP discipline.

titleZh: 数据知识产权：欧盟下一场“围剿”，已瞄准数据！
titleEn: Data IP: The EU's Next 'Encircling' Has Targeted Data
sumZh: 文章对比中国“数据知识产权”与欧盟《数据法案》，认为中国以“有限排他性”和“三权分置”突破传统所有权桎梏，在全球数据规则竞争中具制度前瞻性。
sumEn: The article contrasts China's data IP system with the EU Data Act, arguing China's limited exclusivity approach shows institutional foresight in global data rule competition.
